subject: Request: Bridgewell Analytics logo & byline license for customer spotlight
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@bridgewell.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: permission to use Bridgewell logo and byline in customer spotlight

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the great call yesterday — Bridgewell's ROI numbers and the implementation story will make a concise and compelling customer spotlight for our site and newsletter. We wanted to confirm a few permission items before we go to layout:

- Can we use the Bridgewell primary logo (color) and the name/short byline "Bridgewell Analytics" on the article landing page and the PDF asset?
- Do you need any specific attribution language or trademark notice included?
- Any limitations on using short excerpts of your quote in social posts and the newsletter subject line?

If it's easier, happy to send a short brand asset pack for your legal team to sign off. If you can loop in Nathan from legal that would be great.

Attached: draft spotlight outline (no PII).

Next steps: once we have written permission we'll produce a draft for Bridgewell review that includes the exact logo lockup and proposed byline.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[dylan.brooks@redwood.ai] | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments (1): draft_spotlight_outline.pdf

From: Samira Qureshi <samira@bridgewell.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nathan Cole <nathan.cole@bridgewell.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use Bridgewell logo and byline in customer spotlight

Hi Dylan,

Appreciate the outline — it looks good. From a product/comms perspective we are comfortable with the logo and quote usage for the landing page, PDF, and social. A couple of notes from legal:

- We need to review the specific logo files and the final byline language for trademark formatting (e.g., capitalizations).
- Bridgewell requires a one-paragraph trademark notice in the footer for case studies on third-party sites.
- Please provide a DocuSign or a short signed release with the exact assets you plan to publish.

Looping in Nathan who will coordinate the formal sign-off. He may ask for a short clause in the release limiting use in paid ads without additional permission.

Best,
Samira Qureshi
Head of Customer Success, Bridgewell Analytics
[samira@bridgewell.ai]

Hi Laura / Dylan,

Thanks for including me. I reviewed the proposed scope. To keep this lightweight and avoid back-and-forth, here's what would work for Bridgewell legally: a short logo use release that

- Specifies permitted assets (primary color logo, wordmark),
- Lists permitted channels (redwood.ai website, PDF case study, Redwood newsletters, Redwood-owned social),
- Includes a simple trademark notice for the footer, and
- States that paid ad usage requires additional permission.

If you can send a one-page release we can sign electronically today. Also please include the exact logo files you intend to use.

Thanks,
Nathan Cole
Senior Counsel, Bridgewell Analytics
[nathan.cole@bridgewell.ai]
